installCommand: echo 'Skipping npm install — this is a Flutter web build'
buildCommand: git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1 _flutter && _flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && _flutter/bin/flutter pub get && _flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --dart-define=USE_MOCK=false --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=$API_BASE_URL
